newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK STABLE TO FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK STABLE TO FIRMER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer on the U.S. dollar and the mark but closed stable against pound sterling and the rand on Friday, dealers said.
"I think there was a bit of mixed trading in the morning but towards the end the dollar appreciated -- there were some moderate forex inflows in the market," commented one dealer.
The local currency finished Friday trade at 11.2400/2500 against the U.S. dollar -- one-and-a-half cents up on Thursday's 11.2650/2750 and edged up to 6.7300/7400 from 6.7500/7700 versus the mark.
It was however unchanged against sterling at 18.4600/4800 and at 2.5400/5500 on the rand of South Africa.
